name: dev.mcpharbor.gateway/sec_edgar
title: SEC EDGAR
description: SEC EDGAR filings: 10-K, 10-Q, financials, insider trades, institutional holdings

compliance.attribution: Not required, but citing SEC.gov as source is encouraged
compliance.notes: SEC fair access requires an identifying User-Agent with contact info, and caps 10 requests/second.
compliance.reasoning: SEC states site/EDGAR content "is considered public information and may be copied or further distributed... without the SEC's permission," needs no key, and only imposes a 10 req/s fair-access limit plus a User-Agent identification requirement — nothing bars a paid intermediary.

evidence.quote: declare your user agent in request headers
